The '''Arealleath Corporation''' was a corporation that operated a [[Factory/Legends|factory]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The factory produced a large amount of pollution, which fell to the [[Nar Shaddaa's Undercity|Undercity]] and formed a red haze in [[Sector 340-NJ]].<ref name="LoNH" />
